content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AIIMS Raebareli Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/ salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download AIIMS Raebareli Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Vacancy 2026: Department-wise Seats
content_sections.text: A total of 111 Senior Resident posts are available across 35 departments at AIIMS Raebareli. The category-wise break-up (UR, OBC, SC, ST, EWS) for each department is given below. Note that two departments (Dentistry and ENT/ Otorhinolaryngology, and Obstetrics & Gynecology) currently show zero vacancies in this round. The notification also states that these posts are provisional and may be varied at the discretion of the competent authority, and that 4% horizontal reservation for PwD candidates applies as per Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For the post of Senior Resident (Non-Academic) at AIIMS Raebareli, candidates must meet the following essential qualifications as per the notification: A medical qualification included in the First or Second Schedule, or Part II of the Third Schedule, to the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956 (persons possessing qualifications under Part II of the Third Schedule must also fulfil the conditions specified in Section 13(3) of the Act). Must be registered with the Central Medical Council or a State Medical Council. For a Broad Speciality post: a postgraduate degree — MD/ MS/ DNB — in the concerned speciality, or its equivalent. For a Super Speciality post: MD/ MS/ DNB in the related broad speciality, or DM/ M.Ch/ DNB in the concerned super speciality.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Senior Resident: Maximum age limit is 45 years. Age relaxation is applicable: 5 years for SC/ ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Raebareli Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is conducted by All India Institute of Medical Sciences Raebareli (AIIMS Raebareli) for filling up medical positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: A total of 111 vacancies have been announced for the Senior Resident post across various medical and surgical departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Raebareli Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is strictly Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to appear directly for the interview at the designated venue.

faq.question: Q4. When is the walk-in interview scheduled to take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident posts is scheduled to be held on 06 October 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for applying to these positions?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is set at 45 years, with permissible age relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST and 3 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a recognised medical qualification like MBBS, MD, MS, DNB, DM, or M.Ch along with valid registration with a Central or State Medical Council.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Senior Resident position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a salary as per Pay Matrix Level-11, starting with a minimum of Rs. 67,700/- plus Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA).

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to attend the interview?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for participating in this walk-in recruitment process.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the designated venue, specifically at LT Ground, Medical College Building, AIIMS Raebareli.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates check the official website for updates?
faq.answer: Candidates can visit the official AIIMS Raebareli website at www.aiimsrbl.edu.in for further announcements, updates, and detailed notices.
